ms.promise: In this milestone, we will generated a tor address.
ms.criteria: A public key that links to a tor generated address.
ms.report:
Sadly, we found out it is not possible to generate the address from the public key and that you need the private key for it instead. So, clearly, we cannot share it with the public as that would compromise the service. However, as this was a holder milestone, it is easy to verify, because the server is already up!
I won't be creating new content on how to generate one, as there are hundreds of guides on how to do that, so for example if anyone is interested on generating their own and verifying the address, is the guide we have used. https://opensource.com/article/19/8/how-create-vanity-tor-onion-address

ms.promise: In this milestone, we will setup the Tor proxy server that will host the tor service.
ms.report: The host is up and running. The screenshot https://imgur.com/a/ZJeLVkK

ms.promise: The tor service is going to be setup in beta mode, not yet production.
ms.criteria: Anyone on the the tor network will be able to reach Blockfrost.
ms.report:
The service is live! Yay!
Here is a simple video showing how to access Blockfrost using the Tor network https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=tQUyK18pcpU

ms.promise: The service for Tor endpoint will be released with the blockfrost.dev portal with setup instruction on how to use it.
ms.criteria: Clear documented way and service that is working.
ms.report:
The service is live and documented.
